create_Version_class: create a Version object from a version string like '1.2.3-dev' to parse major, minor, patch, and tag
use_Version_pep440: get a PEP440-compliant version string from a Version object for Python package publishing
use_Version_ruby: get a Ruby-style version string from a Version object with four-part formatting
use_Version_php: get a PHP PECL-compatible version string from a Version object for package distribution
run_mako_plugin: run the mako_plugin function to expand version strings for all supported languages in build settings
